interpretation: The primary 800-pair sample is the validation sample for pair-level R2+A1 baseline target-attribution precision.
The secondary 348-work sample is a work-balanced diagnostic and is not pooled unweighted with the primary sample for overall pair-level precision.
Sampling membership was fixed without using target-attribution judgments.
Risk features are retained for later diagnostic analysis but must be hidden from blind adjudication where they could bias the reviewer.

secondary_work_diagnostic_sample.design: stratified work sample by baseline candidate volume; one pair per work
